body: 阿卡薩航空QP1925班機10月31日由阿默達巴德飛往加爾各答，執飛機型為波音737MAX8，註冊編號VT-YAG。班機在加爾各答內塔吉蘇巴斯錢德拉鮑斯國際機場19L跑道進場時，於當地時間7時37分左右重飛，重飛過程中機尾觸及跑道。

en.title: Akasa Air 737 MAX 8 strikes tail on runway during Kolkata go-around, lands safely on second approach
en.summary: Akasa Air flight QP1925 struck its tail on the runway during a go-around at Kolkata on October 31, then landed safely about 20 minutes later with no injuries reported; the tail strike was found during a post-flight inspection and the aircraft remains in Kolkata for detailed inspection.
body: Akasa Air flight QP1925, a Boeing 737-8 MAX registered VT-YAG, was operating from Ahmedabad to Kolkata on October 31, 2026. During its approach to Runway 19L at Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport at around 7:37 a.m. local time, the crew initiated a go-around, and the aircraft's tail made contact with the runway during the maneuver.

After the go-around, the aircraft climbed to approximately 3,000 feet before joining the circuit for another approach and landing about 20 minutes later, with no injuries reported. Akasa Air confirmed that the crew discontinued the first approach and landed safely on the second attempt, and said the tail strike was discovered during a post-flight inspection. The airline said it had notified the relevant authorities, that the incident was under investigation, and that the aircraft remained at Kolkata for a detailed inspection, without disclosing the extent of the damage or a timeline for its return to service.
